summary: Require an explicit confirmation signal before every live remote POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE across both CLI and MCP orchestration surfaces.
reason: Generated mutation commands and the code-orchestration executor otherwise send remote writes immediately, contradicting the catalog's confirmable-mutation contract.
validated_outcome: Regression tests prove unconfirmed CLI and MCP mutations stop locally before client creation while --yes, --dry-run, and read-only requests remain allowed.
